description: Focused capability verification of the three Negotiation-T fromData generation interfaces: generateNegotiationProposePromptFromData, generateNegotiationAcceptPromptFromData and generateNegotiationRejectPromptFromData. Inputs are traditional structured data - every item is one key (the slot name from the private-line-complaint Task-T template) carrying an atomic value; no natural-language passages, no template-error scenarios. The case matrix is built from the Task-T field model (required: 任务对象/投诉分类/OSS侧事件流水号; optional: 问题发生时间/投诉详情): propose requests every required/optional field combination (all required, each single required, dual required, required+optional, optional-only, empty boundary), accept supplies the filled values for the same combinations, reject carries the unprovidable fields with reasons. Generation is deterministic rendering (no LLM call), so assertions are exact: the generated prompt must carry every item name and value and the matching template URI.
